_meta.rule_under_test: R2 (uncertainty out of range) + R3 (tone contradiction) — section escalation
_meta.direction: NEGATIVE (two FLAGs in same section → ESCALATE both)
_meta.description: Two findings both belong to 3.2.S.3. F-020 has an out-of-range uncertainty score (R2 → FLAG). F-021 has a rationale that says 'complies' while the evidence says 'mismatch' (R3 → FLAG). Because 2 FLAGs exist in the same section, both are promoted to ESCALATE by the section rule.
_meta.author: M5

findings.rationale: The impurity profile from HPLC analysis shows all individual impurities are within ICH Q3A limits.
findings.evidence_snippet: Total impurities: 0.42% (limit 0.5%). All impurities within specification.
findings.citation: ICH Q3A(R2) Impurities in New Drug Substances, Table 1

findings.rationale: The polymorphic form complies with the specified polymorph. XRPD confirms Form I is present and within acceptable limits.
findings.evidence_snippet: XRPD pattern shows mismatch with reference Form I. Characteristic peaks at 2θ = 12.4° and 18.7° are absent.
findings.citation: ICH Q6A Decision Trees for Polymorphism Testing

findings.note: R2: score 115 is outside [0, 100]. Promoted from FLAG to ESCALATE because 2+ FLAGs exist in section 3.2.S.3.
R3: rationale says 'complies / acceptable' while evidence says 'mismatch'. Promoted from FLAG to ESCALATE by the same section rule.
